thread:
Aisha (CSM): Looping in sec/legal — NovaHealth raised questions on SOC2 scope and embeddings retention in their DPA. Need quick triage before renewal sync tomorrow. Summary: they want confirmation that embeddings are ephemeral and KMS BYOK support for Dedicated. Also asked about redaction options. @Jorge can you confirm? @Maya pls prep the playbook.

Jorge (Security): Happy to. Short answer: Hosted API doesn't currently support BYOK; Dedicated+Private do. We have a standard KMS attestation doc. For embeddings, we treat them as persistent by default for indexing unless customer asks to disable. We can offer pseudonymization options.

Maya (Solutions): I'll assemble a one-pager and extract the attestation link. Also will draft the email to Naomi (customer) offering Dedicated trial & data flow diagram. ETA ~2h.

Priya (Legal): We should avoid promising BYOK on hosted. For renewal risk, mark as "open" until BYOK decision confirmed. Send any attestation requests to security-compliance@redwood.com.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks. @Naomi — quick Q: would a Dedicated trial be acceptable for eval? If yes we can fast-track a limited commit. Also need their SOC2 scoping doc; ask them which systems/processes they need in scope.

Naomi (NovaHealth): Yes, trial looks good. I'll check with infra and get SOC2 scope by EOD. Can you share the attestation now?

Jorge (Security): Attestation link: https://redwood.internal/attestations/kms-byo-2025.pdf (internal). Also CLI snippet to rotate keys on Dedicated:
```bash
redwood keys rotate --project novahealth --kms-prefix projects/na/keys/
```

Maya (Solutions): Email draft (paste): "Hi Naomi — sharing attestation & options. We can run a 2-week Dedicated trial with BYOK onboarding; we'll need a signed NCA and SOC2 scope doc. I'll include a data flow diagram and pseudonymization options."

Aisha (CSM): :thumbsup: looks good. Add note about embeddings retention and the option to auto-delete after 30 days.

Priya (Legal): Add legal wording: "subject to product availability and standard procurement terms".

Naomi (NovaHealth): Got it. I'll send scope doc and NCA today. Also curious about pseudonymization—can you outline what's involved?

Jorge (Security): Short bullets:
- Hashing PII at ingestion
- Token filtering (NLP-based)
- Allowlist of fields
- Optional regex-based redaction
We can set up a POC pipeline and sample config.

Aisha (CSM): Great. I'll log this as renewal-risk: high until trial kickoff. Tagging @renewals for visibility.

onboarding-bot: Ticket #CS-12987 created for Dedicated trial + attestation handoff. Assignee: Maya.

Maya (Solutions): I'll upload the one-pager + attestation link to the ticket and ping security for BYOK onboarding checklist.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks everyone — will follow up after Maya uploads. Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
